items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: two of which are in my band at the present time, a young saxophonist named Keith Loftus

ctx.x: NPR. But I can still -- I can use those now. That’s the advantage of that. There was one other -- two other educational settings that I failed to mention that were significant, one of which is going on now. That’s NYU [New York University]. I’m an adjunct professor at NYU at the present moment. I’m -- I teach jazz ensemble and private instruction in saxophone. But the New School [for Social Research], I taught there a couple years ago. There I found an abundance of young talent, some of which -­ two of which are…
